  ENERGY:
    description "Aim for maintenance calories plus 400-500 kcal/day to support breastfeeding. Adjust based on hunger, energy, and weight trends."
  PROTEIN:
    description "At least 1.2g protein per kg bodyweight daily. Prioritize lean meats, eggs, dairy, legumes, tofu, and nuts."
  CARBOHYDRATE:
    description "Include whole grains, fruits, and starchy vegetables at each meal for energy and milk production."
  FAT:
    description "Include healthy fats daily: olive oil, avocado, nuts, seeds, and fatty fish (2x/week if possible)."
  HYDRATION:
    description "Minimum 3L water daily. Drink a glass of water at every nursing session."
  MICRONUTRIENTS:
    description "Continue prenatal vitamins. Focus on calcium (dairy, leafy greens), iron (red meat, beans), vitamin D (supplement if needed), and omega-3 (fatty fish, flaxseed)."

    description "Eat 3 main meals and 2-3 snacks daily. Include a protein source and fruit/vegetable at every meal/snack."

  FOODS_TO_LIMIT:
    description "Limit caffeine to 1-2 cups coffee/day. Avoid alcohol. Limit highly processed foods and added sugars."
  NOTES:
    description "Monitor baby's response to foods. Seek registered dietitian support for allergies, intolerances, or supply concerns."
